findings.issue: When recordingUrl was empty or falsy, CallAudioPlayer mounted a broken <audio src=''> element with active 00:00/00:00 controls instead of an honest empty state.
findings.remediation: Implemented zero-mock fallback returning [data-testid='call-audio-player-empty'] with 'Запись звонка не подключена или недоступна' and optional STT transcript panel.

findings.issue: formatDurationTimer and generateWaveformBars were duplicated between apps/web/src/store/telephonyClinical.ts and packages/shared/src/telephony/formatters.ts.
findings.remediation: Deduplicated by re-exporting canonical implementations directly from @dental/shared.

findings.issue: Toolbar controls had hardcoded min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] Tailwind utility classes, violating desktop clinical density (28-36px) per Mandates 8c and 8d.
findings.remediation: Refactored button styles to compact desktop density (play button 32-36px, skip buttons 32px, speed pills 28px) while maintaining unmount audio cleanup contracts.
